name: Shield
lead: A shield is a defensive tool that can be used to block damage from melee attacks, ranged attacks and explosions. Shields are temporarily disabled when hit by an axe or attacked by a warden using its melee attack while blocking, and certain damage sources ignore a shield's protection. Shields can have ornamental banner designs applied to them.

Shields are used for blocking incoming attacks. Using ‌ [ JE only ] or sneaking ‌ [ BE only ] causes a player to slow to a sneaking pace, and after 5 game ticks (0.25 seconds) , non-piercing attacks coming from in front of the player are blocked, dealing no damage. Shields deal knockback when blocking melee attacks‌ [ BE only ] , unless the entity is immune to knockback. When the shield blocks an attack of 3 HP or stronger, it takes durability damage equal to the strength of the attack rounded up. When a player enters a boat, their shields exhibit the blocking animation. In Bedrock Edition , a shield cannot be activated for ? ticks [ check the code ] after attacking. In Java Edition , attacking while shielding does not perform an attack, while in Bedrock Edition attacks can be performed but lower the shield when doing so.
